report.summary:
Ran `cd E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3/apps/web && npx vitest run test/wp3-no-auth-telemetry.test.ts`. All 114 of 114 tests passed in about 39s. The only other output was the harmless "MISSING DEPENDENCY jsdom" banner; the file runs under `// @vitest-environment node`.

The result does not match the brief, which predicted 110 of 112 with 2 failures. The test file `E:/research-clones/hypergen-p3/apps/web/test/wp3-no-auth-telemetry.test.ts` (modified 19:39) has changed since the brief was written:
1. The acceptance grep test is now named "finds nothing in the WP3 files (word-bounded sentry)". It checks only the files WP3 touched (TOUCHED), citing ADR-016. The test the brief named, "finds nothing under apps/web", no longer exists. A whole-tree `git grep -nIiP "supabase|\bsentry\b|useAuth|@/lib/analytics" -- apps/web` still finds 43 hits in 11 files outside WP3: account-view (20), ai-credits-view, billing-info-view, billing-view, plans-view, shared.tsx, purchase-success.tsx, ai-credits-menu.tsx, upgrade-dialog.tsx, dapi/lib/remote.ts and lib/api.ts. Each file has 2 or 3 hits. A comment in the test says this whole-tree check is a gate at the end of the layer, after WP4/WP5, so it is deferred, not fixed.
2. "no file under apps/web/src calls track(...) or imports @/lib/analytics" now passes for real. It has no exemptions, and plans-view.tsx, shared.tsx and upgrade-dialog.tsx no longer contain any `track(` call or analytics import, because their working-tree changes removed them.
3. There is a new "type check" test that runs tsc and allows errors only in an ALLOWED list of WP4/WP5/genai files. It passes.

Ran `npm run check` (tsc -p tsconfig.app.json). It exits with code 2 and 20 errors, all in files outside WP3: account-view (5), billing-info-view (2), ai-credits-view, billing-view, plans-view, shared.tsx, purchase-success.tsx, ai-credits-menu.tsx, upgrade-dialog.tsx (1 each), dapi/lib/remote.ts (3), dapi/handlers/generate.ts, dapi/local/jobs.ts and lib/api.ts (1 each). Most are TS2307 errors for the deleted `@/context/auth` and `./supabase` modules. remote.ts also fails because 'sign-in-required' is not a valid DapiErrorCode. generate.ts:52 and jobs.ts:72 have type errors that look like they come from the dapi package changes (credits, unknown being assigned to number). No WP3 file has an error. These match the deferred WP4/WP5/genai failures the developer reported, not new failures from this WP.

No HANDOFF baseline was available in this run to compare against. Neither the whole-tree grep nor the full tsc is clean yet; both are expected to pass only after WP4/WP5 and the genai/dapi owners finish.

report.summary:
All WP5 tests pass. The two failures are expected or older than WP5.

**Targeted run:** `npx vitest run test/wp5-fal-generation-core.test.ts` gave 39/39 passing in about 2.8 s.

**Web suite:** the affected suite is apps/web, the only area that changed apart from package-lock.json. `npx vitest run` gave 3 files and 277/277 passing (wp3, wp4 and wp5), with no regressions in WP3 or WP4.

**Exit code:** vitest still exits 1 because of the 'MISSING DEPENDENCY jsdom' warning. This is older than WP5: the WP3 file run alone also exits 1. CI that checks the exit code will flag it until jsdom is installed or the jsdom environment is removed from the config.

**Typecheck:** `pnpm check` cannot find `tsc`, a known issue in HANDOFF. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit` reports 18 errors, all in WP6/WP7 files:
- src/components/genai/* still imports `@diffusionstudio/api-contract` and `@/lib/api`.
- src/dapi/handlers/listen.ts and transcribe.ts still import `../lib/remote`.
- Model ids `qwen3.8-omni-flash` and `universal-3.5-pro` are not in the fal catalog union. These appear in listen.ts:29, transcribe.ts:41 and engine/generate/captions.tsx:57.

These errors follow from WP5's planned deletions. They are new compared with the HANDOFF baseline, where the web typecheck was clean, and should go away once WP6/WP7 are done. None is in a WP5 file.

**Baseline comparison:** HANDOFF records web at 144 passing on main. The P3 branch has its own WP test files, and all of them pass.
